verdict.rationale: RTX PRO 6000 is a physical GPU/workstation hardware product, not a web service or API platform; the notion of a downloadable OpenAPI/machine-readable API spec is a category mismatch for a hardware SKU, even though NVIDIA's broader developer ecosystem includes SDKs like CUDA. Probe evidence confirms no OpenAPI/swagger endpoints exist for this product page, reinforcing that this axis doesn't fit a hardware product line.
